title: 2-to-4 Decoder: One-Hot Output Selection
topic: 2-to-4 line decoder — two input bits select exactly one of four output lines (one-hot). Built from AND gates fed by the inputs and their inverses.

beats.narration: Two address bits, four output lines — and only one of them fires at a time.

elements.content: Two inputs in — exactly one of four outputs out. One-hot.

beats.narration: The truth table lays it out — for each of the four input combinations, exactly one output is high and the other three stay low.

elements.content: Truth table header: A B | Y0 Y1 Y2 Y3

elements.note: Active output highlighted amber row by row

elements.content: exactly one output high per input pattern

beats.narration: Inside, four AND gates each watch for one input pattern — the inputs and their inverses are routed so each gate fires for one and only one combination.

elements.content: Two input lines A, B at top with inverters branching off
Four AND gates stacked vertically — inputs wired (!A,!B), (!A,B), (A,!B), (A,B)
Outputs labelled Y0..Y3 on the right

beats.narration: Step the inputs through all four patterns — and watch the high output hop down the column, one at a time.

elements.content: Input bits A, B shown as a binary counter cycling 00 → 01 → 10 → 11
elements.note: Counter advances every 2s, driven by useSprite() localTime

elements.content: Four output indicators Y0..Y3 — exactly one glows amber each step
elements.note: Active output computed from current (A,B) pair

elements.content: Wires from active gate to its output glow brightly

beats.narration: Two bits give four addresses — and a decoder turns each address into a single chosen line.
